title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 5
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en Quantum Corp y el líder the CFO.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 5)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en Quantum Corp usando SyncCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the CFO.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of Quantum Corp's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are presenting the annual budget spreadsheet. B) They are locking the vault doors. C) The accountants are leaving the building. D) They are filing tax tax returns.
questions.explanation: La descripción A representa al director financiero mostrando el balance contable y proyecciones en la pantalla.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Ashley, did you check the audit reports from Quantum Corp?
W: I did. The CFO wants us to log all tax filings and audit logs in SyncCRM.
M: Got it. I will contact the financial division directly.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in SyncCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to SyncCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Finance Department
*From:* Chief Financial Officer
*Subject: Q3 Audit Preparation & SyncCRM Logging*

Please note that starting next Saturday, all internal expense reports must be finalized and logged via SyncCRM. A prep meeting is scheduled for this Friday at 2:30 PM in the Conference Main Hall.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next Friday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to SyncCRM'.
